Disables the vanilla random "we have other jobs already" denial. Squads still refuse when your companion party is at its limit.
No options for this faction yet.
Blocks neutral Loner squad commanders from offering the vanilla paid escort dialog. Free companion recruitment at friend relation is unchanged.
Low-rank Loners traveling alone may broadcast on your PDA asking for company. Find them on the map and recruit through dialog. Vanilla goodwill recruitment is unchanged.
Anyone on this frequency? I'm near %s and I don't like pushing on alone. — %s
Is anyone close? I'm at %s and this stretch feels wrong without backup. — %s
I saw your message. You don't have to walk alone.
Thanks, stalker. I'll stick with you.
When you complete a quest money payout, split the reward equally among you and your alive Loner companions. Your share is reduced; companions are credited in a PDA tip (not added to their wallets).
Quest reward split equally: %d RU for you, %d RU for %s.
Quest reward split equally: %d RU each for you and your %d companions (%d RU total shared).
When starting a new game as Bandits, spawn companions near you after a short delay. Requires the vanilla Companion system to be enabled. Does not apply to existing saves.
Bandit squad commanders can be hired for timed paid escort (24h / 48h contracts). Vanilla free recruitment at high goodwill is unchanged — paid escort is an additional option.
Base ruble cost for a 24-hour contract (experienced commander, 1 squad member). Final price scales with commander rank and squad size (+100% per extra member). Vanilla reference: 1500.
Base ruble cost for a 48-hour contract (experienced commander, 1 squad member). Final price scales with commander rank and squad size (+100% per extra member). Vanilla reference: 3000.

Merc squad commanders can only be hired on timed contracts (24h / 48h). Goodwill does not grant free companionship — payment is required at neutral or friend relation. Escort price sliders apply even when Faction Tweaks master switch is off.

Monolith players can recruit fellow Monolith field squads through a brotherhood dialog. Requires a non-story ALife squad commander (not debug-spawned loners). Squad headcount cap unchanged.
Brother, walk with me. The path is safer together.
The Monolith provides. I will follow you, brother.
Damage reduction from melee, cuts, and explosions for Monolith stalkers (0-50%)
SiN stalkers ignore wild mutants unless you attack them. Hostility is remembered for 6 in-game hours. While enabled, SiN mutant-hunting tasks are not offered (including stored DRX tasks).
Maximum number of tamed mutant companions for Sin faction (1-10)
How far a tamed mutant can fall behind before it teleports to you (5-50m)

Grants the Cicatrix artifact to SiN players. Full bullet damage reduction while charge is above 0%; hits drain charge. Recharges over time.
Equips SiN NPCs with Cicatrix and reduces bullet damage they take.
